title: Trigger milestone admin route has no linked regression coverage
reasoning: The owned route exposes an admin utility endpoint with a fast_id path parameter, but the included tests exercise permissions for other admin dashboard routes and authentication for other engagement endpoints, not this trigger-milestone route. Because this endpoint is an admin action behind network/user-input/auth boundaries, regressions in URL wiring, allowed methods, authentication, staff-only authorization, missing/invalid fast_id behavior, or response shape would not be caught by the shown test set.
recommendation: Add focused tests for reverse('events:trigger-milestone', args=[fast.id]) covering successful staff/admin access, unauthenticated and non-staff denial, unsupported methods if applicable, and nonexistent fast_id handling.
whyTestsDoNotAlreadyCoverThis: The shown admin tests assert permissions for Django admin dashboard views, and the engagement endpoint tests assert authentication for tracking routes, but none call or reverse the trigger-milestone route declared in events/urls.py.
suggestedRegressionTest: Create tests in an events test module that authenticate as superuser/staff/non-staff/anonymous and request events:trigger-milestone for valid and invalid Fast IDs, asserting the intended status codes and no unintended milestone/event side effects on denied requests.
minimumFixScope: Add route-specific tests; if they fail, apply the smallest auth/method/error-handling fix in the trigger_milestone_check view.
